sections.name: An early lift
sections.reason: The first measured leg rises with high relative activity and range; state a clear motif with bright short accents.

sections.name: The opening gives way
sections.reason: The next leg falls sharply; keep the pulse while the price-derived notes drop.

sections.name: Unsteady ground
sections.reason: A modest net recovery contains substantial movement on lower observed volume; leave more room around the unstable contour.

sections.name: The climb takes hold
sections.reason: This leg contains the 10:56 low and then the strongest sustained rise; let the actual melody climb with a fuller arrangement.

sections.name: Holding altitude
sections.reason: Price drifts lower from the new register while observed activity and range subside; broaden the pad and reduce percussion density.

sections.name: A quieter high
sections.reason: Price climbs toward the afternoon high on relatively quiet observed minutes. Keep the ascent light and preserve the explicitly missing 13:54 minute as silence.

sections.name: Settling above the open
sections.reason: The final leg eases from the high, with more activity near the close. Allow the phrase to descend while its final register remains above the opening.
